title: One Stew for the Festival
story: For the street festival, three families agreed to cook one large stew instead of separate dishes. Rosa wrote down the recipe so the quantities would stay consistent, and she marked which spices were optional. On the morning of the event they tasted the pot and added lemon, not more salt. Visitors returned for a second bowl, which told the cooks the balance was right.

vocabulary.definition: A dish cooked slowly in liquid.
Strong seeds or powders used to flavour food.
A pleasing mix in which no flavour is too strong.

quiz.question: What did the three families agree to cook?
options: One large stew together
Three dishes, one from each family
Lemon sweets for the visitors
A second festival on another street
quiz.explanation: They agreed to cook one large stew instead of separate dishes.
quiz.supportingSentence: For the street festival, three families agreed to cook one large stew instead of separate dishes.

quiz.question: What choice does the written recipe leave open?
options: Some spices can be left out
Every spice must be used in the same amount
The quantities can be ignored
Each family must cook a separate dish
quiz.correctAnswer: Some spices can be left out
quiz.explanation: Rosa marked which spices were optional, so those ones do not have to be included.
quiz.supportingSentence: Rosa wrote down the recipe so the quantities would stay consistent, and she marked which spices were optional.

quiz.question: What were the cooks adjusting that morning?
options: The flavour, by adding lemon rather than salt
The size of the festival crowd
The list of families who would cook
The day on which the event would happen
quiz.correctAnswer: The flavour, by adding lemon rather than salt
quiz.explanation: They tasted the pot and added lemon, not more salt, so they were correcting the taste.
quiz.supportingSentence: On the morning of the event they tasted the pot and added lemon, not more salt.

quiz.question: What does optional mean in this story?
options: Able to be left out
Required in every pot
Tasting strongly of lemon
Written after the festival
quiz.explanation: Optional spices are the ones the cooks are allowed to skip.
quiz.supportingSentence: Rosa wrote down the recipe so the quantities would stay consistent, and she marked which spices were optional.

quiz.question: Why did they taste the pot on the morning of the event?
options: They wanted to adjust the flavour before people ate
They wanted to cancel the festival
They wanted to hide the recipe
They wanted to add salt and nothing else
quiz.correctAnswer: They wanted to adjust the flavour before people ate
quiz.explanation: They tasted the stew that morning and then added lemon, which changed the flavour before serving.
quiz.supportingSentence: On the morning of the event they tasted the pot and added lemon, not more salt.
